source.reproduction_note: Mechanism-informed pilot, not a reproduction of the paper's complete training configuration.

environment.name: 2D Shapes block-pushing compatibility environment
environment.palette: Matplotlib Set1, sampled as official utils.get_colors(num_colors=9)
environment.collision_rule: An object moves one grid cell only if the destination is in bounds and unoccupied; otherwise the state is unchanged.
environment.behavior_policy: Uniform random over all 20 actions, including invalid actions.
compatibility_changes: Standalone NumPy renderer and environment preserve the pinned source's object, action, boundary, and collision semantics without importing Gym 0.12.
Episode randomness uses split and episode-indexed NumPy Generator streams rather than the legacy source's mixed global NumPy and Gym RNGs.

The integer-pixel rasterizer follows the source's 10-pixel cell geometry and circle/triangle/square shapes; it is a compatibility renderer, not claimed pixel-identical to every historical scikit-image/Matplotlib version.

stored_arrays.event: uint8 [episodes, 40], diagnostics only: 0 free, 1 other-object-blocked, 2 boundary-blocked

data.model_input_rule: Predictor and encoder training may read only obs and action. Position and event arrays are reserved for train-only position probes or held-out diagnostics as specified; they never enter a predictor input or Stage A loss.

representation.encoder: Pinned C-SWM small-style extractor: 10x10 stride-10 feature maps with shared per-slot encoder MLP; hidden_dim=128, embedding_dim=16.

stage_a_encoder_fit.method: C-SWM-style contrastive state-transition objective with joint encoder and full-pair GNN fitting

stage_b_predictor_fit.encoder: Frozen Stage A encoder from the matching seed; all seven predictors initialized and fitted from scratch.
stage_b_predictor_fit.objective: one-step latent MSE + 0.5 * mean free-running latent MSE over horizons 1..5; divide both terms by train-only mean squared latent-delta energy.
stage_b_predictor_fit.paired_minibatches: Within each encoder seed, precomputed episode/start-index minibatch draws are identical across all seven predictor arms.
stage_b_predictor_fit.action_interface: Scalar actions 0..19; every arm receives the equivalent five per-slot 4D one-hot direction vectors, with only the selected object's vector nonzero.
stage_b_predictor_fit.local_predictor: Shared across slots; input is own 16D slot, own 4D action vector, and optional message.

message_comparison.local4: Five independent bias-free 16->4 slot projections; each slot reads only its own 4D projection.
message_comparison.global4: One bias-free 80->4 projection of all slots, shared as input to each slot predictor.
message_comparison.global16: One bias-free 80->16 projection of all slots, shared as input to each slot predictor.
message_comparison.local4_global4_projection_parameters: Exactly matched at 320; local4 vs global4 is the primary communication contrast.

stage_b_predictor_fit.transformer6: Six Transformer encoder layers, 4 attention heads, d_model=128, FFN=512, five slot tokens and learned slot embeddings; this is a new shared-interface comparator, not an existing LeWM checkpoint.
stage_b_predictor_fit.flat_mlp_matched: Single flattened state/action MLP; hidden width selected before training so total trainable parameters are within 5% of global4.
stage_b_predictor_fit.full_gnn: C-SWM-style fully connected directed pair messages and node aggregation, hidden_dim=128; serves as visual reference.

evaluation.primary_metric: C-SWM-style held-out H@1 for action-conditioned latent target retrieval at horizon 10 using a fixed same-seed candidate bank.
evaluation.rollout_start: step 0 of each held-out test episode; each episode is first summarized as one unit.
evaluation.candidate_bank: For each horizon, one true target is inserted exactly once with targets from the other held-out episodes of the same seed; the candidate episode set/order is fixed and shared by every arm and persistence. No position-based filtering is allowed.
evaluation.ranking: Squared Euclidean latent distance; stable lexicographic tie-break prioritizes the true candidate, matching the official evaluator's deterministic positive-first tie convention. Report latent variance alongside retrieval metrics.
evaluation.subset_rule: One-step metrics use every held-out test transition and classify its attempted action from stored held-out position diagnostics; rollout metrics at each horizon are stratified by the step-0 action category. GT diagnostics never select or remove test episodes.
evaluation.action_response: Held-out counterfactual pairs start from the same image/latent and compare an observed action with a fixed alternate object-action; compare predicted and true encoded latent differences. Counterfactual images are generated only for evaluation, using the frozen encoder.
evaluation.persistence_reference: No-training predictor z_hat=z_t, evaluated with identical horizons and candidate banks.
evaluation.position_probe: Fit frozen linear slot-to-position readouts using train images/latent and train positions only; resolve slot/object assignment using train data only; report held-out test position error as auxiliary encoder diagnostic.
evaluation.baseline_adequacy_per_seed: Full GNN test H@1 >= 0.80 at h1 and >= 0.50 at h10, and full GNN h10 exceeds persistence h10 by >= 0.05. All three seeds must pass before calling the visual reference adequate; otherwise finish every fit and label visual comparison inconclusive.
evaluation.bootstrap: 1000 episode-level paired bootstrap resamples within each training seed; report each seed separately and do not infer a training-seed population effect.

timing.scope: Predictor-only complete rollout including message and token operations; measure encoder initial-cost separately. Same GPU allocation, precision, and synchronization policy for all arms.
timing.telemetry: GPU utilization and memory every 30 seconds in the job log.

gates.quality: For each seed, h10 H@1 may be at most 0.03 lower than full_gnn; report absolute H@1 and H@1 difference.
gates.speed: At least 20% lower predictor-only full-rollout latency than full_gnn and transformer6 separately; B=1 and B=300 reported separately.
gates.mechanism: global4 vs local4 is the primary communication comparison; flat_mlp_matched distinguishes structural benefit from parameter-count reduction.
gates.interpretation: Only label an arm quality-and-speed promising if it passes both gates on the same seed and batch-size latency condition; preserve failures and inconclusive outcomes.
